description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and deliver high-quality RTL for complex DRAM, memory, and mixed-signal digital blocks, driving projects from architecture and specification through implementation handoff while meeting performance, power, area, and quality targets.
 Own front-end ASIC design activities, including RTL development, linting, CDC/RDC verification, functional validation, logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), timing constraint definition, and timing closure across multi-mode, multi-corner operating conditions.
 Develop, maintain, and optimize design constraints (SDC), including clock definitions, timing exceptions, I/O constraints, UPF-based power intent, and low-power implementation methodologies to achieve optimal PPA.
 Collaborate closely with architecture, verification, circuit design, and physical implementation teams to resolve integration challenges, improve design robustness, and ensure successful product execution.
 Analyze synthesis and timing reports, identify critical bottlenecks, and drive design improvements to meet performance, power, area, and schedule objectives.
 Chip in to the development and enhancement of design methodologies, automation frameworks, and RTL-to-GDS implementation flows, improving engineering productivity, design quality, and time-to-market.
 Apply strong expertise in CMOS digital and mixed-signal concepts, Verilog/System Verilog, and industry-standard EDA tools to develop scalable and reliable silicon solutions.
 Champion continuous improvement initiatives by demonstrating automation, AI-assisted engineering technologies, and generative AI tools to enhance design efficiency, collaboration, and overall engineering effectiveness.
 Demonstrate strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills while mentoring peers and chipping in to a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
 
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 10+ years of relevant ASIC or SoC design experience, with significant ownership of complex front-end design projects. For a principal or senior technical-lead position, 12–15+ years may be preferred.
 Advanced proficiency in RTL design and microarchitecture development using Verilog and SystemVerilog.
 Validated ability to take designs from architecture and specification through RTL implementation, verification support, synthesis, timing closure, and implementation handoff.
 
 About Micron Technology, Inc. 
 We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life   for all . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. 

 To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers 

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

 To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations,   please contact hrsupport_india@micron.com 
 
 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
 
 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.
 
 AI alert : Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.   
 
 Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.
